models.name: ChapterDocument
models.work: schema, repo, submit/review actions; add history[] (spec amendment A3)

build: Spec amendment A3: add `history: { version: number; document_url: string; submitted_at: Timestamp; reviewed_at?: Timestamp; status: string }[]` to ChapterDocument; update types, registry and note it in docs/fypms-docs.md section 13.
models/chapter (schema, repo): deterministic id `${teamId}__ch${n}`, chapter_number 1..5, title.
src/lib/chapters/url.ts (pure): accept only https links on drive.google.com, docs.google.com, 1drv.ms, onedrive.live.com or *.sharepoint.com. Unit-tested.

src/app/actions/review-chapter.ts: only the team's assigned supervisor; approve or revision_needed with line-item feedback entries (ChapterFeedback); sets reviewed_at; notify the team; when chapter 5 is approved set team.status defense_ready.
Server tests: sequence enforcement, URL allowlist, history growth, only assigned supervisor can review, defense_ready transition.
assumptions: Any team member may submit; defense_ready is set automatically when chapter 5 is approved
acceptance: Submitting chapter 3 before chapter 2 is approved returns an error
